display.purpose: The landing hero only. One per site, set in per-character spans for the staggered reveal.

headline.purpose: Page titles and the footer brand mark.

title.purpose: Project names and article titles in listings.

lede.purpose: Hero sub-headline and the centered introductory statement. Always graphite.

body.purpose: Running prose, capped at a 68ch measure.

label.purpose: Categories, years, counts, and figure numbers, in Safelight. Captions are the same face in lower case and graphite.

motion.name: ease-house
motion.purpose: Every transition and reveal in the system. The only easing curve permitted.

motion.name: dur-reveal
motion.purpose: Staggered text reveals sliding up from translateY(100%).

motion.name: dur-image
motion.purpose: Plate hover: grayscale(1) to grayscale(0) with a 1.05x scale.

motion.name: dur-state
motion.purpose: The floor for any hover or state transition.

motion.name: dur-marquee
motion.purpose: One full marquee track cycle, linear and infinite, paused on container hover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The filled call to action. Inverts on hover rather than darkening.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; background: #000; color: #fff; padding: 20px 40px; border: 1px solid #000; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Iosevka', 'Iosevka Nerd Font', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 14px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-decoration: none; transition: background 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #fff; color: #000; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C72C12; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Link
components.description: Unfilled action. A 1px rule wipes in from the left on hover.
components.css: .ds-link-underline { position: relative; display: inline-block; color: #000; padding-bottom: 6px; font-family: 'Iosevka', 'Iosevka Nerd Font', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 14px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-link-underline::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; width: 100%; height: 1px; background: #000; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-link-underline:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-link-underline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C72C12; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Metadata Label
components.description: The mono caption voice: categories, years, counts.
components.css: .ds-label { display: inline-block; margin-right: 24px; color: #C72C12; font-family: 'Iosevka', 'Iosevka Nerd Font', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 14px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: A 4:3 plate over a hairline-ruled metadata row. The plate desaturates in and scales on hover.
components.css: .ds-card { display: block; color: #000; text-decoration: none; } .ds-card-frame { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 4/3; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; } .ds-card-plate { width: 100%; height: 100%; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 1px, transparent 1px 14px); filter: grayscale(1); transition: filter 700ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-plate { filter: grayscale(0); transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-card-meta { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 24px; margin-top: 16px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.10); } .ds-card-meta h3 { margin: 0; margin-right: auto; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .ds-card-meta span { color: #C72C12; font-family: 'Iosevka', 'Iosevka Nerd Font', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 14px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; }

components.name: Fixed Navigation
components.description: Difference-blended header that stays legible over paper and pitch alike.
components.html: yg
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 24px; mix-blend-mode: difference; color: #fff; } .ds-nav-mark { color: inherit; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.05em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-toggle { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; background: none; border: 0; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav-toggle:hover { transform: rotate(90deg); }

components.name: Difference Cursor
components.description: 32px lagging circle that inverts whatever sits beneath it. Fine-pointer devices only.
components.css: .ds-cursor { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 32px; height: 32px; margin: -16px 0 0 -16px; border: 1px solid #000; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; mix-blend-mode: difference; pointer-events: none; z-index: 9999; transition: transform 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-cursor[data-grow='true'] { transform: scale(2.5); }

narrative.overview:
A studio monograph in ink on paper. The pages are white, the type is enormous and set tight, and every image is a plate — a black-and-white technical drawing of a real system this person built. The register is a design studio's, not a lab's: the confidence comes from scale and restraint, not from terminal chrome or dashboard furniture.

Discipline is the whole argument. Hierarchy comes from size, weight, and the amount of paper around a thing. Safelight is a thin red accent; teal stays secondary. A 12vw headline against a 14px tracked mono label is the system's entire dynamic range, and it is enough. Motion is the second material: everything eases on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) and nothing snaps, so the page feels weighted rather than animated.

The plates are the counterweight to all that type. Each project carries a drawn figure — a blimp envelope with its EKF trace, five pipeline stages, a network graph, a step response curve — in hairline black on white. They read as evidence, not decoration, and they are the only place the page gets busy.
keyCharacteristics: Ink and paper for body copy. Safelight leads; teal is secondary and sparse.
Type at two extremes — enormous display, small tracked mono — with little in between.
Hairline rules (1px) as the only dividing device.
Asymmetric corner radii on marquee plates; near-square everywhere else.
Continuous horizontal motion in the marquee; slow reveals everywhere else.
A custom difference-blend cursor replaces the system pointer on fine-pointer devices.

rules.name: The Safelight Rule
rules.body: Body copy stays ink on paper, or paper on pitch. Safelight marks links, labels, focus, selection, and one thin rule. It never fills a region and never means an error. Teal is for code, diagram lines, and info notes, and it is never full strength beside Safelight.

rules.name: The Grey Ladder Rule
rules.body: On paper: ink, then graphite for support text. Mist is a rule, not small text. On pitch the readable muted step is mist.

rules.name: The Two Extremes Rule
rules.body: Type is either very large or very small. A page needing a size between the title (24px) and the headline is usually a page whose hierarchy needs rethinking, not a new step in the scale.

rules.name: The Tracking Inversion Rule
rules.body: Tracking runs negative as size runs up (-0.05em at display) and positive as size runs down (+0.1em on 14px mono). The two never meet in the middle.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: A box-shadow in this system is a bug. If an element needs to feel lifted, give it space or a rule; if it needs to feel above the page, use difference blending.

dos: Do keep every transition at 500ms or longer on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).
Do use the 1px Rule line as the only divider, on paper or inverse.
Do set labels in 14px mono, uppercase, 0.1em tracking, in Safelight. Set captions in the same face, lower case, in graphite.
Do give the marquee plates their three-card asymmetric radius cycle; the irregularity is the point.
Do gate the custom cursor behind (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) and collapse every animation under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
Do let sections breathe at clamp(96px, 12vw, 200px).
donts: Don't fill a region with Safelight or teal, set body copy in either, or put the two at full strength side by side.
Don't use a border heavier than 1px anywhere.
Don't add a box-shadow; this system has no elevation vocabulary.
Don't use the platform's default easing (ease, ease-in-out, linear for anything but the marquee track).
Don't let mono type run longer than a short label — it is a caption voice, not a body voice.
Don't reintroduce the retired terminal world: no window chrome, no prompt glyphs, no status LEDs, no blueprint grid, no theme toggle.
